related.title: Gatekeeper：參照式政策的同步資料與過期快取
related.titleEn: Gatekeeper: synchronized inventory and stale referential decisions
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：60%與70%可重算，一位attestor與可變tag負例均拒絕；驗收綁定最後物件的精確摘要。 交付kyverno-image-chain.csv、attestor矩陣及tag改指向負例；只使用離線物件描述。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Reproduce 60 and 70 percent and reject single-attestor and mutable-tag cases, binding acceptance to the exact digest in the final object. Deliver kyverno-image-chain.csv, the attestor matrix and tag-retargeting counterexamples using offline object descriptors, with no registry writes or cluster admission changes.
related.difference: 建立20個應同步的namespace/物件描述，列來源版本、快取版本與查詢路徑；以同名標籤衝突模型測試缺資料與已同步資料。
related.differenceEn: Build 20 expected namespace/object descriptors with source revision, cached revision and inventory path. Use a duplicate-label model to compare absent data with synchronized data, recording cluster-scoped and namespaced paths separately.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 本課要求至少兩個指定attestor驗證成功，且最終引用含已驗證摘要；門檻計數與所有證明內容條件分開，簽章有效不能代替predicate檢查。 10筆中8筆滿足兩位attestor，當中6筆最終引用也固化正確摘要；2筆雖簽章足額但仍使用可變tag。 完整准入率6/10×100=60%；修正一筆足額簽章映像的摘要引用後為7/10×100=70%。
本課以已同步且版本符合物件數衡量覆蓋率；同步通常有延遲，100%當下覆蓋也不保證之後兩個並行准入不競爭。 20個預期物件中15個已進入正確inventory路徑且版本相符，5個缺失或過期；固定GVK與namespace範圍。 覆蓋率15/20×100=75%；補同步其中3個後為18/20×100=90%，另2個仍需保留未決。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: The local policy requires two specified attestors to verify and the final reference to contain the verified digest. Keep threshold counting separate from attestation-content conditions; valid signatures do not automatically establish an acceptable predicate. Eight of ten images satisfy the two-attestor requirement, and six of those also carry the correct immutable final digest. Two have sufficient signatures but still use a mutable tag, so they remain unacceptable under the combined contract. Full admission is 6/10×100=60 percent. Correcting the digest reference for one sufficiently signed image yields 7/10×100=70 percent, while another unpinned image remains rejected.

Measure coverage as objects synchronized at the expected revision. Synchronization has delay, and even full coverage at one instant does not prove that two subsequent concurrent admissions cannot race; this is an observation metric, not a transactional uniqueness guarantee. Fifteen of 20 expected objects occupy the correct inventory paths with matching revisions. Five are missing or stale. Fix the GVK and namespace scope so excluded kinds are not silently treated as successful synchronization. Coverage is 15/20×100=75 percent. Synchronizing three more gives 18/20×100=90 percent, leaving two unresolved; the increase does not establish a global freshness guarantee.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Grafana Loki：標籤基數與租戶公平預算
related.titleEn: Grafana Loki: label cardinality and tenant fairness budgets
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：60%與70%可重算，一位attestor與可變tag負例均拒絕；驗收綁定最後物件的精確摘要。 交付kyverno-image-chain.csv、attestor矩陣及tag改指向負例；只使用離線物件描述。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Reproduce 60 and 70 percent and reject single-attestor and mutable-tag cases, binding acceptance to the exact digest in the final object. Deliver kyverno-image-chain.csv, the attestor matrix and tag-retargeting counterexamples using offline object descriptors, with no registry writes or cluster admission changes.
related.difference: 列出穩定標籤與高變動欄位，為兩個租戶建立每日串流基數及稽核可搜尋性對照。
related.differenceEn: Separate stable labels from high-churn fields and compare daily stream cardinality with audit searchability for two tenants.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 本課要求至少兩個指定attestor驗證成功，且最終引用含已驗證摘要；門檻計數與所有證明內容條件分開，簽章有效不能代替predicate檢查。 10筆中8筆滿足兩位attestor，當中6筆最終引用也固化正確摘要；2筆雖簽章足額但仍使用可變tag。 完整准入率6/10×100=60%；修正一筆足額簽章映像的摘要引用後為7/10×100=70%。
完全組合的上界是各標籤取值數乘積；實際基數需由觀察集合計數，不可把上界當實測。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 教學資料有10服務、4環境、3區域，且每組都有事件；另有200個請求ID跨全部組合出現。 穩定標籤產生10×4×3=120串流；把請求ID加進去變24000串流。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: The local policy requires two specified attestors to verify and the final reference to contain the verified digest. Keep threshold counting separate from attestation-content conditions; valid signatures do not automatically establish an acceptable predicate. Eight of ten images satisfy the two-attestor requirement, and six of those also carry the correct immutable final digest. Two have sufficient signatures but still use a mutable tag, so they remain unacceptable under the combined contract. Full admission is 6/10×100=60 percent. Correcting the digest reference for one sufficiently signed image yields 7/10×100=70 percent, while another unpinned image remains rejected.

The Cartesian-product upper bound multiplies label cardinalities; observed stream counts require actual distinct tuples. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. The fixture populates all combinations of ten services, four environments and three regions; two hundred request IDs also cross every combination. Stable labels produce 120 streams; including request ID yields 24000 streams in this fully populated fixture.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
